Diagnostic Methodology

How the 20-Point AI Citation Diagnostic Works

Evaluating your web presence against the exact algorithmic standards used by generative AI retrieval engines:

🤖

1. AI Crawler & Bot Directives

Audits your robots.txt for explicit permissions covering GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and Google-Extended, ensuring agents can discover and index your content.

🕸️

2. Schema.org Knowledge Graph

Validates connected JSON-LD schemas (Organization, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage) with canonical entity IDs and external authority anchors.

⚡

3. AEO Zero-Click Answer Snippets

Evaluates whether critical buying queries are answered within high-density 40–55 word passages formatted for immediate extraction by ChatGPT Search and Google AI Overviews.

🛡️

4. Brand Truth & Anti-Drift Defense

Checks machine-readable manifests (/llms.txt, /ai.txt) to prevent foundation models from citing outdated pricing, obsolete competitors, or hallucinated specs.

Frequently Asked Questions About AI Citation Audits

What every modern brand needs to know about generative search indexing.

What is an AI Citation Readiness Audit?

An AI Citation Readiness Audit tests whether your website is structured for generative AI discovery. It inspects crawler access for GPTBot and PerplexityBot, validates Schema.org entity graphs, and checks for 40–55 word direct-answer passages that AI search engines require for citations.

How does GEO differ from traditional SEO auditing?

Traditional SEO audits focus on blue links, backlink volume, and keyword density. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) audits focus on machine extraction: entity disambiguation in Wikidata/Schema ontologies, RAG chunking density, and immutable brand ground truth that prevents LLM hallucinations.

Is the Answer Index audit completely free?

Yes. The diagnostic scan runs instantly in your browser and compiles a downloadable 2-page Executive PDF report with actionable remediation steps at zero cost.
